newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi says "pretty happy" with rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi says "pretty happy" with rate cut.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Friday he was pleased with the Bank of Italy's surprise half-point cut in interest rates.
"I'm pretty happy," he told reporters after the Bank lowered its key discount rate to 6.25 percent from 6.75 percent.

Prodi and other ministers, along with business leaders and unions, have long urged Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio to cut interest rates in the face of steady falls in inflation. The Bank last altered its discount rate in January.
"I think that the governor expects a certain continuity from the government and the country," Prodi said. "I think that his slowness has a justification. I am satisfied."
